home.description: Welcome to AI Toolbox, your high-performance desktop gateway to local large language models. Manage your Ollama library, monitor real-time generation, and analyze your usage with a professional, developer-centric interface.
home.featureChatDesc: Connect with any local model instantly. Experience low-latency, private, and secure AI interactions.
home.featureModelsDesc: Seamlessly pull, update, and manage your Ollama model library with advanced monitoring.
home.featureStatsDesc: Deep dive into your local AI consumption. Track tokens, performance, and historical trends.
home.featureSettingsDesc: Customize your model parameters, server connections, and application preferences.
home.footer: Built for the local AI community. Powered by Tauri & Ollama.
